_about: Robots.txt product tokens Lighthouse obeys (the keeper, 8 November 2026; AGENTS.md, Rules that matter). scripts/robots_rules.py reads this file: a group naming "lighthouse" or the running provider's applied tokens (every provider's when it cannot tell) applies, else "*"; the strictest applicable group wins. "documented" means the provider's own page lists the token; "seen in the wild" means a robots.txt Lighthouse read addresses the provider's agents by that name and no provider page read lists it. Entries with "applied": false would be recorded, not obeyed; none is. Pages retained under notes/robots-tokens-2026-11-08/sources/ (fetchlog.csv gives URL, UTC time, status and sha256). Written 8 November 2026.
